title: IDF Strikes Kill Three Hamas Commanders — Including Ex-Jailer of Freed Hostages Alexander and Zangauker — Plus At Least 4 Palestinians Across Gaza
detail: On Thursday, August 27, 2026, Israeli forces carried out a series of strikes across Gaza. In Khan Younis, the IDF killed Ismail Mohammed Ibrahim Barim, whom it identified as a Hamas military commander who had held hostages Edan Alexander, Matan Zangauker and Avera Mengistu in a tunnel in southern Gaza before their release; the military said he had 'recently advanced attacks on troops and Israeli civilians' and helped restore Hamas capabilities while 'systematically violating the ceasefire.' A separate strike in Gaza City's Shati refugee camp killed Bilal Ibrahim Saleh Raqi'i, identified as a commander in Hamas's anti-tank unit, and another strike in Khan Younis killed Azzam Rifaat Abd Abadala of Hamas's Khan Younis Brigade. Alongside the targeted strikes, at least four Palestinians were killed in incidents Al Jazeera and Wafa attributed to Israeli fire: one in an attack on a displaced-persons tent west of Gaza City, one in a drone strike on a tent in the al-Mawasi area of Khan Younis, one in a drone strike on an electric bicycle at the al-Sinaa intersection, and one more in a separate Gaza City drone strike; several others were wounded, one critically. Defense Minister Israel Katz separately renewed threats to expel Palestinians from areas where kites and balloons are launched from Gaza, saying 'a balloon and kite shall be treated the same as a drone — with or without explosives.' Gaza's health ministry said more than 1,300 Palestinians have now been killed since the October 2025 ceasefire began, against roughly four Israeli soldiers over the same period.

media.caption: Palestinians inspect damage after an Israeli strike in Gaza City, August 27, 2026

confidenceReason: Named Hamas commander strikes confirmed directly by IDF statements identifying each target, corroborated by Times of Israel liveblog reporting; the additional civilian casualties are reported by Al Jazeera citing Wafa and Gaza health officials and are not disputed by the IDF, which has not detailed the individual targets of those strikes.

title: Van Hollen, Kaine and Sanders Unveil Privileged Senate Resolution Demanding Accounting for 9 Americans Killed in West Bank
detail: On Thursday, August 27, 2026, Senators Chris Van Hollen, Tim Kaine and Bernie Sanders, joined by eight Democratic colleagues including Elizabeth Warren, Ed Markey, Mazie Hirono and Jeff Merkley, announced a privileged resolution under Section 502B(c) of the Foreign Assistance Act demanding the State Department report to Congress within 30 days on investigations into the killings of nine American citizens by Israeli settlers or security forces in the West Bank, and on the human rights situation there, including the detention of Palestinian children. The move is separate from a sign-on letter sent to Prime Minister Netanyahu a day earlier by most of the Senate Democratic caucus; unlike that letter, the 502B resolution carries statutory teeth, potentially restricting security assistance if the administration fails to comply. Van Hollen said 'American citizens have been killed time and again, and they have received no justice and no accountability,' while Sanders said 'the United States cannot keep bankrolling this violence and looking the other way.' Warren said the Trump administration 'has reversed sanctions against individuals connected to this violence.' The push followed a confrontation earlier in August between Israeli forces and settlers at the West Bank home of a Palestinian-American family in Qusra.
